review.evidence: Pinned Ethereum block 26197384 (2026-10-15T10:41:59Z; hash 0xfe4eaf54384aae47b1a503ea6fb142c136e5297bc6cf4a8f59ded1f0fafe36bb) confirms the control observation above. EIP-1967 implementation is zero and the full runtime matches the verified direct deployment (SHA-256 of RPC hex text 8083ee33b2ffebb03840723b825870bddd813d51fb8d9f3c83e0e37c37d74e85). owner() is immutable Core 0xc07e000044f95655c11fda4cd37f70a94d7e0a7d; its current voter() is 0x11111111063874ce8dc6232cb5c1c849359476e6, still different from the manifest's legacy VOTER. Complete indexed OperatorSet replay has 86 events and 23 active tuples; every active tuple agrees with pinned operatorPermissions and has a zero hook. None targets the savings vault, and none of the eight global selector permissions intersects its callable mutators. Core voter can authorize future parameter actions, but fixed source cannot add privileged native share minting. Core alone can set the reward-distribution cap (currently 6341958396 per second per 1e18 assets), LayerZero peer/delegate, message inspector, precrime and enforced options; ownership cannot transfer after initialization. Endpoint delegates(vault)=Core, msgInspector()=preCrime()=zero. These non-mint roles do not create an additional native liability. No native blacklist, seizure, pause, arbitrary-call or asset-recovery function exists. Reward-cycle rollover can call registry.feeDeposit().operator().distribute(); the pinned fee deposit is 0x07ad4630985ade5b5307806c43e57e0a9a932c52, its operator is 0xc700000506423bad12d5eb6d55b35ea9f5384df6, and both vault getEpoch() and fee-deposit lastDistributedEpoch() are 83. This external call is an execution dependency, not a native mint or withdrawal-delay power. Full indexed PeerSet history is empty and vault-held share escrow is zero; empty supplemental logs do not independently prove absence. The issuer's audit index and both linked reports were reopened: January/February 2025 protocol reviews predate the August 2025 savings deployment and do not establish savings-specific audit coverage, financial assurance, legal priority or signer independence.
